rules: Magic link / token change → test the full flow in a real browser: send → arrive in inbox → click → land on correct page. Console log is not a substitute for inbox delivery
Auth callback change → test with a completely fresh browser session (incognito, no existing cookies) — most auth bugs only appear on first login, not on sessions that are already established
Email template change → send to a real inbox before deploying; check spam folder, plain-text fallback, and subject line rendering on mobile
Token expiry change → explicitly test the expired case: a token that is past expiry must be rejected with a clear user message, not a silent failure or a crash
Middleware auth guard change → test three paths: (1) no session → correct redirect, (2) valid session → correct pass-through, (3) expired session → correct re-auth prompt
_comment: Starter for projects with magic link or token-based auth. Rules cover the class of bugs that only appear in real browsers and real inboxes — never in unit tests.
